stem: A bullet fired into a fixed target loses half of its velocity after penetrating 3 cm. How much further it will penetrate before coming to rest assuming that it faces constant resistance to motion?

assets.alt: A bullet moving right at speed u enters a block at A, reaches B after 3 cm with speed u/2, and stops at C a further distance x on.
Velocity–time graph: a straight line from u at t = 0 to zero at 2τ, passing u/2 at τ. The area up to τ is 3 cm and the remaining triangle is x; the areas are in the ratio 3 : 1.
